visual_action: The video opens with a series of shots of the White House South Portico decorated with rainbow-colored columns (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) — imagery from a Pride Month event. A close-up shows two women emerging from the South Portico entrance flanked by U.S. Marines in dress whites; one woman wears a light green pantsuit and waves, the other wears a rainbow-gradient dress. A subsequent shot shows the White House balcony with a large Progress Pride flag (rainbow + transgender + brown/black stripes + chevron) hanging centrally between two large American flags. Another shot shows a crowd on the South Lawn watching performers on a stage with rainbow-colored columns in the background; a performer in a silver sequined jumpsuit sings into a microphone. The video then cuts to a black screen with the text "two years later ❤️." This transitions to footage of Donald Trump and Melania Trump walking solemnly in formal dark attire, flanked by military personnel and a fire truck, in what appears to be a ceremonial procession. Next, Trump appears outdoors in a royal blue suit, standing with others on a green lawn watching as a U.S. flag is unfurled or presented. The video ends with a wide exterior shot of the White House South Portico showing white columns (undecorated), an American flag flying on a flagpole in the foreground under a blue sky — presenting the White House in its standard, undecorated appearance.
